title: Part 2: Morty Finds a Way Out

cuts.voiceover_text: Morty's new family has one solution for stopping him from running away: make him strong enough to stay. They throw him into the dark woods and leave him scrambling through the trees, while a lantern-bearing man appears behind him. Morty keeps moving, shaken but determined, until he finds a hollow and a bag. Inside is a red journal. The pages are filled with handwritten notes and directions, including one huge clue: Yosemite. This is no longer just an escape. Someone left a trail before him. Who wrote the journal, and does it lead Morty home?

series.summary: Morty is forced into the woods to make him strong enough to stay, where he finds a journal and a possible path home.
